title: Use AHashMap for built-ins functions in shaders
body:
This change should improve overall compile performance for the shaders with a lot of built-in function usage, because:

-  The name string/tag checking is removed
- 	It will search only on specific function subset from a `AHashMap` by a string key

Also, this should reduce the binary size, by removing redundant members from `BuiltinFuncDef`.

- Fix https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/115464
